title: JANUS Linear A SigLA-native directed formula-neighborhood discovery
research_question: Do any directed adjacent SigLA word-identity pairs recur across multiple documents more strongly than both document-composition-preserving identity shuffles and endpoint-marginal-preserving rewires predict, and do locked pairs reproduce in disjoint partitions?

source_and_blinding.eligible_word: Fully resolved sign-ID sequence only; ambiguous/nonstandard word forms become fixed MASK slots rather than being deleted.
source_and_blinding.candidate_identity: SHA256 of exact sign-ID word sequence; transliteration unavailable until statistical state is frozen.

relation.edge: A→B only when A and B occupy immediately adjacent eligible word slots in the original SigLA document word order; MASK prevents adjacency across unresolved forms.
relation.statistic: observed directed edge occurrence count; enrichment effect = observed count - mean null count

destructive_nulls.operator: Shuffle eligible word identities only among eligible slots within each document; preserve document membership, eligible-word multiset, word count, MASK slots and adjacency geometry.
Across observed eligible adjacency edge instances, preserve the multiset of left endpoints and right endpoints while randomly permuting right endpoints.
destructive_nulls.destroys: specific A→B endpoint coupling while preserving endpoint marginals

SCREEN.multiplicity: For each null separately, Bonferroni over all eligible directed-pair hypotheses; pair selected only if effect>0 and corrected p<=0.05 under BOTH nulls.

CONFIRM.multiplicity: Bonferroni over SCREEN-selected pairs under each null; survivor requires both nulls.

TEST.multiplicity: Bonferroni over CONFIRM survivors under each null; survivor requires both nulls.

claim_ceiling.forbidden: Assigning lexical meaning or grammatical translation from adjacency alone.

roadmap_after_execution.if_full_survivor: Post-score novelty audit + known-formula subtraction in a separately frozen test + independent implementation replay.
roadmap_after_execution.if_no_full_survivor: Preserve negative result and elevate canonical state; next scientific bottleneck becomes genuinely independent L3 transcription or a new behavioral channel, not threshold relaxation.
